Archival Dispatch: 29 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Bob and Ray, The Adventures of Uncle Jimmy, This Is the Story, and The World Tomorrow

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 5 min
Tags: Bob and Ray, Mary Backstayge, Satire, Uncle Jimmy, William Farnum, Warner Brothers, This Is the Story, Robert Ripley, Gene Autry, Herbert W Armstrong, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 54 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 54 resolves 29 historic radio broadcasts across classic comedy satire, pre-WWII syndicated serials, narrative history, and international broadcasting: 8 legendary satirical broadcasts from Bob and Ray (1953–1976, featuring the foundational run of their celebrated parody Mary Backstayge, Noble Wife, WNBC studio broadcasts, and the WOR mystery show), 7 episodes of Warner Brothers' 1938 syndicated daily drama The Adventures of Uncle Jimmy (starring silent cinema star William Farnum), 8 narrative docudramas from This Is the Story (covering Mary Pickford, Robert Ripley, Gutenberg's press, Gene Autry, Yehudi Menuhin, Ulysses S. Grant, and AFRS Tour of Duty), and 6 theological and geopolitical radio addresses from Herbert W. Armstrong's The World Tomorrow (1980–1982).
